mapper.select: SELECT cr.* FROM cardRoom cr JOIN cardRoomMember crm ON cr.id = crm.roomId WHERE crm.userId = #{userId} AND crm.status = 0 AND cr.status = 0 AND cr.isDelete = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT userId FROM cardRoomMember WHERE roomId = #{roomId} AND status = 0

SELECT cr.id AS roomId, cr.roomCode, owner.username AS ownerName, cr.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cardRoomMember count_member WHERE count_member.roomId = cr.id) AS memberCount, COALESCE(crm.settleScore, crm.totalScore, 0) AS score, cr.createTime, cr.settleTime FROM cardRoom cr JOIN cardRoomMember crm ON crm.roomId = cr.id LEFT JOIN user owner ON owner.id = cr.ownerId WHERE crm.userId = #{userId} AND cr.isDelete = 0 ORDER BY cr.createTime DESC, cr.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cr.id FROM cardRoom cr WHERE cr.status = 1 AND cr.isDelete = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cardRoomMember existing_member WHERE existing_member.roomId = cr.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cardRoomMember member WHERE member.roomId = cr.id AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cardRoom newer_room JOIN cardRoomMember newer_member ON newer_member.roomId = newer_room.id WHERE newer_member.userId = member.userId AND newer_room.status = 1 AND newer_room.isDelete = 0 AND ( newer_room.createTime > cr.createTime OR ( newer_room.createTime = cr.createTime AND newer_room.id > cr.id ) ) ) < #{retainCount} )
